_how_to_edit: Add stores to 'stores', then add weekly events to 'weekly' and one-off events to 'special'. Times are 24-hour Central time (19:00 = 7 PM). Delete the sample entries (sample: true) once you have real ones. Sample entries are hidden from social posts.
